name: Oronok’s trained felboars
shortDescription: The trained felboars used to dig Shadowmoon tubers at Oronok’s farm.
body: The trained felboars used to dig Shadowmoon tubers at Oronok’s farm. Visual details are original generated research art, not canonical model evidence. Composition, markings, costume and exact game resemblance await human comparison with the target Burning Crusade client.
